name: grimmsnarl_ml_v27
policy: v22 remains the default policy. The measured v24 mirror Froslass guard is restored. In a public exact-list mirror only, v25 supplies a candidate and an exact-card-count belief search first evaluates H2; only ambiguous, tactical, sufficiently observed positions may extend to H3 with 3, 5, 7, or 9 worlds. Every override must dominate v22 in every sampled world, preserve prize/deck-out safety, and clear a 0.04 mean value margin.

belief_search.matchup: public exact-list Grimmsnarl mirror signature only
belief_search.base_horizon: current own turn + opponent turn + next own turn
belief_search.adaptive_horizon: one additional opponent and own turn (H3) only after an ambiguous H2
belief_search.opponent_policy: determinization-level ensemble alternating deterministic rules and the v25 peer ranker
belief_search.hidden_state: strict without-replacement sampling after subtracting all public evolution stacks, attachments, tools, stadiums, known hand cards, and known prizes
belief_search.acceptance: no sampled world below v22; no worse prize exchange; no new deck-out; at least five H3 worlds and 0.04 mean gain for an H3 override
belief_search.fallback: v22 on disagreement, weak belief, non-tactical state, missing state, impossible card counts, engine error, incomplete branch, or budget stop

mirror_froslass.behavior: avoid an unnecessary additional Froslass when a legal alternative exists

proactive_route: concentrate spare Punk Up energy on one Morgrem
complete a one-energy Morgrem without starving the primary attacker
reserve the fifth Bench slot when a third Munkidori would erase the route

deck_clock.scope: turn 10+, optional Lillie refill can empty deck, while ahead or already attack-ready

policy_escalation.effective_runtime: same as v22; the global teacher pin already equals the escalation teacher

v26_early_ladder_diagnosis.interpretation: too small and turn-order-skewed to identify an H2 regression; fourteen of fifteen games were outside H2's mirror scope

known_limits: H3 is intentionally limited to public exact-list mirrors and tactical positions; it is not a universal minimax search.
The value model is weakest on turns 1-4 (AUC 0.7196), so search is disabled there.
A sampled hidden world is plausible under the known deck multiset, not a prediction of the opponent's actual hand.
v27 ladder strength remains unverified until it is submitted and compared over a materially larger, turn-order-balanced sample.
description: Belief-corrected adaptive H2/H3 mirror planner with v22 fallback, v24 Froslass guard, v25 peer/opponent candidates, and targeted wall/deck-out recovery.
